name: Paper Cup
preparation: Remove the plastic lid and any remaining liquid. Tear off the plastic-coated rim if present. Keep dry.
facility: 3-colour recycling bins (paper) in Main Library and Chow Yei Ching Building

name: Office Paper
preparation: Remove staples, paper clips and plastic tape. Keep the paper dry. Do not include shredded paper.
facility: 3-colour recycling bins (paper) at Run Run Shaw Library and Academic Building

name: Cardboard Box
preparation: Flatten the box. Remove all tape, labels and polystyrene packing. Keep clean and dry.
facility: Paper recycling at Main Library loading area and Run Run Shaw Library

name: Newspaper / Magazine
preparation: Remove any plastic wrap or free gift inserts. Keep dry.
facility: 3-colour recycling bins (paper) at Jockey Club Tower and Main Building

name: Plastic Bottle
preparation: Empty and rinse. Remove the cap and label. Crush to save space. Do not include dirty/oily bottles.
facility: 8-in-1 / smart recycling bins (plastics) at Run Run Shaw Library and Chow Yei Ching Building

name: Plastic Food Container
preparation: Empty food residue and rinse. Remove rubber lids. Heavily greasy containers go to general waste.
facility: 8-in-1 recycling bins (plastics) at Academic Building and AZE

name: Yoghurt / Dairy Cup
preparation: Rinse out residue and peel off foil lid. Dry before recycling.
facility: 8-in-1 recycling bins (plastics) at Run Run Shaw Library

name: Plastic Bag / Film
preparation: Clean and dry. Bundle several bags together so they are not blown away.
facility: 8-in-1 recycling bins (plastics) at Main Building

name: Aluminium Can
preparation: Empty and rinse. Crush if possible. Do not include aerosol or pressurised cans.
facility: 3-colour recycling bins (metals) at Chow Yei Ching Building and Loke Yew Hall

name: Tin / Steel Can
preparation: Empty and rinse. Remove sharp lids if possible and tape them down inside the can.
facility: 3-colour recycling bins (metals) at Main Library

name: Metal Bottle
preparation: Empty and rinse. Remove rubber seals. Keep intact.
facility: 3-colour recycling bins (metals) at Academic Building

name: Glass Bottle
preparation: Empty and rinse. Remove the cap. Do NOT include broken or chipped glass.
facility: Glass recycling bins at Chow Yei Ching Building and Main Library

name: Glass Jar
preparation: Rinse out contents. Remove metal/plastic lid and recycle it separately.
facility: Glass recycling bins at Run Run Shaw Library

name: Beverage Carton
preparation: Empty all liquid. Remove straw and plastic cap. Cut open, rinse and flatten to dry.
facility: Beverage carton collection bins at Main Library and Chow Yei Ching Building

name: Mobile Phone
preparation: Delete all personal data and sign out of accounts. Remove the case. Keep the battery inside.
facility: E-waste / WEEE collection point at Main Building and Run Run Shaw Library

name: Laptop / Computer
preparation: Back up then wipe personal data and sign out. Remove accessories. Keep intact.
facility: E-waste / WEEE collection point at Main Building and Academic Building

name: Keyboard / Mouse
preparation: Wipe clean. Bundle cables with a tie. No personal data applies.
facility: E-waste / WEEE collection point at Academic Building

name: Charger / Cable
preparation: Coil and tie the cable. Keep the plug intact.
facility: E-waste / WEEE collection point at Run Run Shaw Library

name: Used Clothing
preparation: Wash and dry. Put items in a tied bag so they stay clean and dry.
facility: Conservancy Association used-clothes bin near Chow Yei Ching Building

name: Shoes / Bags
preparation: Clean and dry. Pair shoes and place in a tied bag.
facility: Used-clothes collection bin near Chow Yei Ching Building

name: Food Waste
preparation: Drain liquid. Remove non-food items (bones larger than fingers, packaging, cutlery).
facility: Food waste collection bins at campus pantries and dining areas

name: Coffee Grounds / Tea Leaves
preparation: Drain liquid. Remove staples/tags from tea bags. Do not include the paper cup.
facility: Food waste collection bins at pantries near Chow Yei Ching Building

name: Fluorescent Tube / Lamp
preparation: Place the used tube back into a new-tube packaging to prevent breakage. Handle with care.
facility: Special hazardous-waste collection (arrange via Facilities Office)

name: Printer Toner / Cartridge
preparation: Keep in its original bag/box to avoid powder leaks. Do not open the drum.
facility: E-waste / consumables collection at Academic Building

name: Staples / Paper Clips
preparation: Too small to recycle; place in general waste. Remove them from paper first.
facility: General waste bins in all teaching buildings

name: Receipt / Thermal Paper
preparation: Thermal/coated paper is not accepted in paper recycling. Put in general waste.
facility: General waste bins near pantries and lift lobbies

name: Tissue / Wet Wipe
preparation: Soiled or wet paper cannot be recycled. Place in general waste.
facility: General waste bins in washrooms and pantries

name: Styrofoam / Polystyrene
preparation: Rinse off food. Most campus bins do not accept foam; otherwise place in general waste.
facility: General waste bins near dining areas (foam not widely accepted)

name: Mask / PPE
preparation: Personal protective equipment goes to general waste. Do not recycle.
facility: General waste bins at building entrances

name: Cigarette Butt
preparation: Ensure fully extinguished. Place in general waste; never in recycling bins.
facility: General waste bins at designated smoking areas

name: Chewing Gum
preparation: Wrap in paper and place in general waste.
facility: General waste bins in dining areas

name: Ceramic Mug
preparation: Ceramics are not recyclable with glass. Wrap broken pieces and use general waste.
facility: General waste bins in pantries

name: Toothbrush / Pen
preparation: Small mixed-material items are not accepted; place in general waste.
facility: General waste bins in teaching buildings
